HasBuiltInOverlay.rationale: `public override bool HasBuiltInOverlay => true` (Infection.cs:18) tells the card renderer the art already includes its own overlay frame. Presentation, out of scope, and the sim has no card-visual layer.

CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Unplayable }` (Infection.cs:22) == `is_playable = False`. No Ethereal, so unlike card/dazed this Status stays in hand and keeps hurting.

ctor.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign), CONFIRMED against current source 2026-08-04: `Card.energy_cost` (`sts2_rl/cards/base.py:422-443`, was `:222-232`) short-circuits on `self._energy_cost < 0` as its first check (`base.py:433-434`), returning the raw canonical value before consulting `_free_this_turn` / `_cost_this_turn` / `_cost_this_combat` / `_cost_delta_this_turn` -- mirrors `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers`'s `if (_base < 0) return num;` short-circuit (`CardEnergyCost.cs:101-104`), which runs before any local or global modifier. Infection sets `self._energy_cost = -1` in `_init_vars` (infection.py:31), matching `base(-1, CardType.Status, ...)`. Readers: combat play/auto-play/valid_actions/action-mask sites gate on `is_playable` first and never see -1; every global-modifier site routes through `hooks.modify_card_energy_cost`, whose dispatcher ends `return max(0, cost)`, so what is SPENT and what the observation encoder reads (`full_env.py:700-744` card_features via `previews.py` preview_card_energy_cost) are unchanged. DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1`, and `events/infested_automaton.py` (now via `reward_pool_card_ids`, not `pool_card_ids` -- the event was refactored since this record's last audit) still excludes curses/statuses at its two call sites: `_study` filters to `CardType.POWER` (infested_automaton.py:53) and `_touch_core` filters `energy_cost == 0` (infested_automaton.py:61), and Infection's canonical cost is -1, not 0, so neither offer can surface it. New pins: test/test_unplayable_cost.py (15 tests, still present).

CanonicalVars.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign), CONFIRMED against current source 2026-08-04: Infection now stores `self._damage = 3` in `_init_vars` (infection.py:32), so `Card.base_damage`/`magic_number` report 3 instead of None, matching `new DamageVar(3m, ValueProp.Unpowered | ValueProp.Move)` (Infection.cs:20). `full_env.card_features` (full_env.py:700-744, was `:455-489`) reads the fixed value. The prop set is unchanged and still right: `DamageCmd.deal` infers `DamageProps.CARD_UNPOWERED` from `card.is_unpowered = True` (cmds.py:270-289, was `:44-50`; infection.py:27, was `:153`), so the 3 damage is not Strength-scaled and IS blockable on both sides, identical to card/burn and card/decay. Pins: test/test_printed_vars.py (48 tests, still present).

OnTurnEndInHand.rationale: `CreatureCmd.Damage(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Damage, this)` (Infection.cs:39) -- passing the VAR, so the props ride along -- == `DamageCmd.deal(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, self._damage, dealer=None, card=self)`. Explicit null dealer on both sides. Presentation, folded in: the bloody-impact VFX and the NWormyImpactVfx node (33-38).

OnPlay.rationale: Infection.cs declares no OnPlay and the card is Unplayable.
